When physical assessment findings indicate potential pathologies in the renal system, testing can assist in 
diagnosing the issue. GFR will indicate if there is a decrease in the function of the kidneys when the results are less 
than normal. Serum creatinine should be tested with the BUN results to evaluate kidney function. If the creatinine is 
high and the BUN is high, kidney functioning is insufficient. Table 15.1 lists laboratory tests typically performed to 
evaluate possible renal system issues and their relationship to the renal system.
